The Void Patch is an upgrade for the Practitioner's Pouch that enhances its ability to store void-related items and components. This patch is particularly useful for mages who frequently work with void magic or need to store large quantities of void motes.

To apply the Void Patch, I need to combine it with a Practitioner's Pouch in a crafting table. Once applied, the patch will permanently enhance the pouch, allowing it to hold more void-related items and providing additional functionality.

The Void Patch also adds a unique visual effect to the pouch, making it easily identifiable among other pouches.
